split_policy.primary_axis: behavior phase before recovery directory label, dispatch fixture label, native compile-args sidecar, generated report, evidence-log row, old-mode label, gate label, retired route label, compatibility label, or migration label
split_policy.positive_rule: recovery dispatch fixtures may cite positive behavior only through hand-authored Objective-C 3 source rows owned by parser, sema, lowering, IR, runtime, or e2e owner splits; meta sidecars, compile arguments, directory labels, generated reports, and evidence-log rows are not positive behavior truth
split_policy.provenance_rule: native compile arguments, configurable dispatch arity labels, recovery directory labels, parser draft labels, source inventory rows, sidecar metadata, generated-only rows, evidence-log rows, migration-only rows, old-mode rows, gate rows, retired route rows, and compatibility rows remain provenance unless a phase owner claims the underlying hand-authored behavior
split_policy.retired_surface_rule: old-mode dispatch, compatibility dispatch, gate dispatch, retired route dispatch, generated-only recovery, evidence-log recovery, migration-only recovery, unsupported dispatch arity, alternate acceptance, runner-only execution, and positive claims derived only from sidecars are canonical rejection, strict-error, absent-support, or provenance-only evidence
split_policy.e2e_boundary_rule: this recovery dispatch family does not create positive end-to-end execution support; executable success belongs in native execution or e2e fixture owners, with this family providing source/provenance routing only
